description: This file implements Spearman's rank correlation coefficient calculations for RDDs in Apache Spark's MLlib, including methods for computing correlation between two datasets and generating a correlation matrix from an RDD of vectors.

classes.name: SpearmanCorrelation
classes.description: Object providing methods to compute Spearman's correlation and correlation matrix for RDDs of Doubles or Vectors.

methods.name: computeCorrelation
methods.description: Computes Spearman's correlation between two RDD[Double] datasets.

methods.name: computeCorrelationMatrix
methods.description: Computes the Spearman correlation matrix for an RDD[Vector].
